exercise_verification_record.literal_prompt: Translate the word problem below into an equation; then solve. Transport #1 and Transport #2 left the loading dock at noon and headed in opposite directions. If Transport #1 traveled at 60 mph and Transport #2 traveled at 68 mph, how many hours was it before they were 384 miles apart?

independent_mathematical_review.derivation: Opposite directions add distances: (60+68)t=384. Thus t=384/128=3 hours, giving distances 180 and 204 miles; 180+204=384.
independent_mathematical_review.domain: t≥0; equal elapsed time for both transports.

mathematical_review.method: independent rate-distance equation, exact elapsed time, positive physical result and both distances
